units.source_text: 这些情书的纸色、墨迹和熏香之气，各不相同，各得其妙。

en.t: The colors of the paper, the traces of ink, and the scent of incense in these love letters were all different, each with its own charm.

units.source_text: 众侍女都说：“将来和这些人一概断绝，也太寂寞了。”

en.t: All the ladies-in-waiting said, "It would be far too lonely to cut off ties with all these people in the future."

units.source_text: 玉鬘不知有何感想，只对萤兵部卿亲王略复数字：

en.t: No one knew what Tamakazura thought of it, but she sent only a few words in reply to Prince Hotaru, the Hyobu-kyo:
